description: This Dart source file defines the `DocumentRepository` class, which provides CRUD operations, querying, and change notifications for document records stored in a local SQLite database using the `sqflite` package. It manages document data, emits change events, and ensures secure database interactions, serving as a key part of the data layer in a Flutter application.

classes.name: DocumentRepository
classes.description: A class that manages CRUD operations for documents, emits change events via a broadcast stream, and interacts with the SQLite database.

methods.name: createDocument
methods.description: Creates a new document record and emits a creation event.

methods.name: getDocumentById
methods.description: Retrieves a document by its ID.

methods.name: getAllDocuments
methods.description: Retrieves all documents ordered by the latest update.

methods.name: getDocumentsByFolder
methods.description: Retrieves documents by their folder ID or uncategorized if null.

methods.name: updateDocument
methods.description: Updates a document's fields; emits an update event.

methods.name: deleteDocument
methods.description: Deletes a document by ID and emits a delete event.

methods.name: searchDocuments
methods.description: Searches documents by name or tags using LIKE.

methods.name: moveDocuments
methods.description: Reassigns documents from one folder to another.
